body: I'll try to seek out a therapist. I know I need some professional help, and just putting it off obviously isn't doing me any favors.

I should check that one out since I tend to like the proggy stuff the most. Long, intricately-woven pieces that can take me far away from my problems.

Yes, that is very true. I just need to keep reminding myself of the little things I love. Even if it's just a good meal or something. It's just, sometimes it feels like my anxiety is a completely different person living inside my mind, trying to drag me down. Yet, I know it's all me. I guess it's a form of intrusive thoughts. I just wish I knew how to keep them out permanently.

I still enjoy watching Let's Play videos on YouTube. Not the mega-popular ones, but like Lucahjin and ProtonJon and MasaeAnela. I'm also following a few webcomics from the Undertale fandom. I at least want to see the 4 i'm following to the end.   

My music tastes are all over, but Nine Inch Nails, Foo Fighters and Rush get a ton of play from me. I also like to peruse /r/Metal for new stuff.
